svg.title: Guild Queue — card-based interface concept
svg.desc: A guild-only dungeon queue with multiple role and dungeon selections. Twelve example players form two suggested groups and two unmatched individuals. The player's group has a click-only Create party button. An additional preview shows its disabled state and explanatory tooltip when already grouped.
svg.text: Guild members with the addon only
Scroll for the full dungeon list
Common dungeons: The Deadmines · Shadowfang Keep
You + 4 guildmates. Everyone must accept their invitation.
Invitations are sent only when you click Create party. Leave the queue once your party is formed.
You are already in a party or raid.
Leave your current group to create a new party.
Visual concept with sample data — not an in-game screenshot or a change to the addon layout.
